description:
Run a read-only GraphQL query against a CoreModels project's model — the general query escape hatch for precise questions (projections, traversals, counts) that the fixed read tools don't answer. Viewer access is required, same as the app.

The schema is GENERATED PER PROJECT: field names are camelCased from this project's labels and cannot be guessed. Always call with schemaOnly=true first and write queries against the returned SDL (standard introspection queries also work, but the SDL is far cheaper). Root fields: types, elements, taxonomies, views, exemplars, spaces, mixins, relationGroups. Node roots take filter arguments id, ids, names, spaceId — note `names` is a search expression, not an exact match.

Queries only: the schema has no Mutation or Subscription type. GraphQL variables and operationName are not supported — inline all literals into the query document.

There is NO pagination and every matched node is returned with all its relations, so select narrowly and always filter. Results whose serialized data exceeds maxChars come back as { truncated: true, totalChars, maxChars, dataPreview } instead of { data } — tighten the query rather than raising maxChars. On a GraphQL error (usually a wrong field name) you get an error result; re-check the schema with schemaOnly=true.

graphProjectId.description: Id of the project to query. Viewer access is required.

maxChars.description: Cap on the serialized result size. The server has no pagination; over the cap you get truncated:true with a string preview instead of data.

query.description: GraphQL query document (query operations only; no variables — inline all literals). Required unless schemaOnly is true.

schemaOnly.description: Return the project's generated GraphQL schema as SDL without executing anything. Call this first: field names are camelCased from this project's labels.

name: query_model_graphql
